hero.title: 451° is a <accent>book battle</accent>
hero.subtitle: Immerse yourself in the world of literature — team up, read, and compete for the semester crown.

page.subtitle: 451° is a game where teams of students compete by reading books — one book a month, one semester, one champion.

why.title: Why 451°?
why.coverAlt: Fahrenheit 451 by Ray Bradbury — book cover
why.body: 451 °F is the temperature at which book paper catches fire. In Bradbury’s world, books are burned. In ours, books are what set readers on fire.

goals.title: What the game is for
goals.habit: Build a lasting reading habit among students through gamification.
goals.readers: Grow the number of young people who read.
goals.community: Bring young people with shared interests together into one community.

entryFee.title: Entry fee
entryFee.bodyWithReceipt: Taking part costs {fee}. Pay by bank transfer and attach the receipt when you register your team.

team.title: Play as a team
team.body: You compete as a team of 3 players. Every point a teammate earns counts toward the team total.

telegram.title: Join the Telegram channel
telegram.body: Every participant must subscribe to the 451° Telegram channel. Announcements, votes and quiz dates are posted there.

vote.title: Books are chosen by vote
vote.body: Players vote on what the league reads next. The book with the most votes becomes the read of the month.

season.title: 4 months, 4 books, 3 languages
season.body: The season runs for one semester: one book each month, with books in three languages across the season.

winner.title: Highest score wins
winner.body: At the end of the semester, the team with the most points is crowned the 451° champion.

gamification.title: Gamification means using game elements to make something genuinely fun.
gamification.body: Teams, votes, points and live quiz nights turn reading into a season worth winning.

champion.title: One team takes the crown
champion.body: When the semester ends, the team with the most points is named the 451° champion and takes home the season’s prizes.
champion.motto: Today a reader, tomorrow a leader.

rulebook.copyright: The 451° game format is protected by copyright · © 2026 NATS Spirea
